_note: Recall quality dims left untested by the increment-1 A/B (which used a zero-overlap paraphrase set). Each section is an isolated store + labelled queries. precision dims score @1 (the top hit must be THE right note among confusable neighbors); others score hit@k. The scale dim reuses recall_dataset.json plus ~100 generated distractors (see bench_quality.py).
